subject: Invoice for my records
body:
Hi team,

Could you send me a copy of the invoice for order LM-574552? I need it for my expense report.

Thank you.
Ananya

subject: Cannot export history
body:
Hello support,

When I try to export my device history I get 'Error 5012: export failed'. I have tried on web and mobile. I need this report for an audit on Friday.

Thanks in advance.

subject: App crashes on start
body:
Hi,

The app crashes on launch every single time on my phone and my tablet. Nothing in my home can be controlled. I need this working today.

Noah

subject: Cannot log in at all
body:
Hello support,

I cannot log in. The password reset email never arrives, I have checked spam, and I am logged out on every device. I have no access to anything.

Thanks,
Aarav

subject: Devices not syncing
body:
Hi,

Changes I make on my phone do not show up on my tablet until I log out and back in. Both are on the latest version.

Thanks,
Olivia

body:
Hi team,

I just noticed a renewal charge of $129.50. I thought I had turned auto-renew off. Please look into it.

Thank you.
Mateo

subject: Change delivery address
body:
To whom it may concern,

Can you redirect order LM-803798 to my office? I will not be home this week.

Please advise.
Grace

body:
Hey,

My Lumora Hub shows different settings in the app and on the web dashboard. Which one is right, and how do I get them to match?

Thanks in advance.

body:
To whom it may concern,

Please tell me what data your devices collect and who it is shared with. I would like this in writing.

Aarav

body:
Good morning,

Can you redirect order LM-656088 to my office? I will not be home this week.

Thank you.
Sofia

body:
Hi team,

I was charged twice for order LM-769927. Both charges of ₹199.00 show on my statement from the same day. Please reverse one of them.

Thanks,
Ethan

subject: Lost my two-factor phone
body:
Hi,

My phone was stolen and it had my authenticator app. I am still logged in on my laptop for now, but I will be locked out when the session ends. How do I move two-factor to a new phone?

Thank you.
Fatima

subject: Great product
body:
Hey,

Your support agent last week was really helpful. Please pass on my thanks.

Thanks in advance.
Tom

subject: Cannot export history
body:
To whom it may concern,

The schedule feature stopped working. Saved schedules no longer run and saving a new one shows an error. Everything else works.

Cheers,
Mei

subject: Broken on arrival
body:
Hi team,

The package for order LM-320224 was wet and torn, and the device inside does not turn on.

Kind regards,

subject: Received the wrong product
body:
Hey,

I ordered a Lumora Plug but the box contained a different product. Order number LM-778558. How do I get the right one?

Also, a separate thing: it would be great if the app had a dark mode. The white screen is very bright at night.

subject: Unbelievable
body: Honestly shocking that I cannot find where to download last month's receipt. Worst website I have used. Where is it?!

subject: Delivery time question
body:

How long does standard delivery usually take to Canada? I am thinking of ordering a Lumora Plug.

Thanks,

Hi,

How do I change the card used for my subscription? My current one expires next month.

It would be great if the app had a dark mode. The white screen is very bright at night.

Please advise.
Daniel

subject: Job application
body:
Good morning,

I would like to apply for an internship. Where should I send my CV?

Regards,
Julia

subject: Close my account
body:
Hello,

Please delete my account and all data linked to it. I no longer use the product.

Cheers,
Ananya

subject: Do you ship to my country?
body:
Good morning,

Do you offer express shipping, and what does it cost?

Kind regards,
Ethan

subject: Export fails
body:
Hi,

The schedule feature stopped working. Saved schedules no longer run and saving a new one shows an error. Everything else works.

Thanks,
Ethan

subject: Fraud on my account?
body:
Hello,

There are 3 charges from Lumora on my card in the last hour that I did not make, totalling several hundred. I have not ordered anything. Please stop these immediately.

Julia

subject: Received the wrong product
body:
Hi team,

I ordered a Lumora Sense but the box contained a different product. Order number LM-630748. How do I get the right one?

Please advise.
Omar

subject: Small question when you have a moment
body: Hello, sorry to bother you, and no rush at all. I noticed a few payments on my card from your shop this morning that I do not remember making, and a couple more seem to have appeared while I was writing this. Probably nothing. Could someone have a look when convenient? Many thanks.

subject: Formal complaint
body:
To whom it may concern,

This is my third complaint with no reply. If I do not hear back within 48 hours, I will be taking this to my solicitor and the consumer ombudsman.

Thanks,
